name: 3dcms
description: Build, edit and publish real 3D websites by describing them.

interface.longDescription: 3dCMS turns a conversation into a walkable 3D web page. Describe a scene and ChatGPT builds it in your 3dCMS account: rooms, signs, images, models, lighting and links. Ask for changes in plain words, check a screenshot or a design review, and publish to a shareable link when you are happy. Every edit is checkpointed, so you can roll back from the editor. Needs a 3dCMS account (Google sign-in).
defaultPrompt: Make me a 3D gallery for my photography portfolio with three rooms.
Take a screenshot of my latest scene and give me a design review.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the reviewer account's scenes, each with an editor link.

positive.description: Creates a new scene with a simple object and an entry camera
positive.prompt: Create a 3dCMS scene called Reviewer Test with a red box on a floor and a camera facing it
positive.expected_behavior: A new scene id and editor link are returned; the scene holds a floor, a red box and an entry camera.

positive.prompt: In my 3dCMS scene Reviewer Test, make the box blue and move it one meter left
positive.expected_behavior: The box color changes to blue and its x position drops by 1.

positive.description: Shows what a scene looks like
positive.prompt: Show me what my 3dCMS scene Reviewer Test looks like
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a rendered image of the scene.

positive.prompt: Review the design of my 3dCMS scene Reviewer Test
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of findings about framing, lighting and the visitor's way out.

negative.description: Publishing needs the user's explicit confirmation
Paid AI model generation is not offered on this connector
negative.prompt: Use 3dCMS to generate a 3D model of a chair with AI

negative.description: Another account's scene is not reachable
negative.prompt: Open 3dCMS scene src-00000000 and show me its contents

publication.release_notes: First release: build, edit, screenshot, review and publish 3dCMS scenes from ChatGPT.
